dhikr_cards.name: Talbiyah
dhikr_cards.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللّٰهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
dhikr_cards.transliteration: Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, Labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, Innal hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, La sharika lak
dhikr_cards.translation: Here I am O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Indeed all praise, blessings and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.

dhikr_cards.name: Takbeer
dhikr_cards.arabic: اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ، وَاللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلِلّٰهِ الْحَمْدُ
dhikr_cards.transliteration: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, La ilaha illallah, Wallahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Wa lillahil hamd
dhikr_cards.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. There is no god but Allah. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. And to Allah belongs all praise.

dhikr_cards.name: Tahleel
dhikr_cards.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
dhikr_cards.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
dhikr_cards.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. To Him belongs sovereignty and all praise, and He is over all things capable.

dhikr_cards.name: Tasbeeh
dhikr_cards.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ الْعَظِيمِ
dhikr_cards.translation: Glory be to Allah and His is the praise. Glory be to Allah the Magnificent.

dhikr_cards.name: Istighfar
dhikr_cards.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
dhikr_cards.transliteration: Astaghfirullaha al-azeemal-ladhi la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyumu wa atubu ilaih
dhikr_cards.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah the Magnificent, there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.

dhikr_cards.name: Salawat an-Nabi
dhikr_cards.arabic: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلٰى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلٰى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
dhikr_cards.transliteration: Allahumma salli ala Muhammadin wa ala ali Muhammadin kama sallayta ala Ibrahima wa ala ali Ibrahima innaka Hamidun Majid
dhikr_cards.translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim. Indeed You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

dhikr_cards.name: Dua During Tawaf
dhikr_cards.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
dhikr_cards.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina azaban-nar
dhikr_cards.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.

dhikr_cards.name: Dua at Safa & Marwa
dhikr_cards.arabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللّٰهِ، أَبْدَأُ بِمَا بَدَأَ اللّٰهُ بِهِ
dhikr_cards.transliteration: Innas-safa wal-marwata min sha'a'irillah, abda'u bima bada'allahu bihi
dhikr_cards.translation: Indeed Safa and Marwa are from the signs of Allah. I begin with what Allah began with.

dhikr_cards.name: Best Dua of Arafat
dhikr_cards.arabic: لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
dhikr_cards.transliteration: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahul mulku wa lahul hamdu, yuhyi wa yumitu wa huwa ala kulli shay'in qadir
dhikr_cards.translation: There is no god but Allah alone, no partner has He. To Him belongs all sovereignty and all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He has power over all things.

dhikr_cards.name: Hasbunallah
dhikr_cards.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ، نِعْمَ الْمَوْلٰى وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ
dhikr_cards.transliteration: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakil, ni'mal mawla wa ni'man-nasir
dhikr_cards.translation: Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best disposer of affairs. The best protector and the best helper.

takbeerat.name: Takbeer for Hajj and Eid
takbeerat.arabic: اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ، وَاللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلِلّٰهِ الْحَمْدُ
takbeerat.transliteration: Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, La ilaha illallah, Wallahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Wa lillahil hamd
takbeerat.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. There is no god except Allah. Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. And all praise belongs to Allah.

talbiyah.name: Talbiyah
talbiyah.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللّٰهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ
talbiyah.transliteration: Labbayka Allahumma labbayk, Labbayka la sharika laka labbayk, Innal hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, La sharika lak
talbiyah.translation: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Indeed all praise, blessings, and sovereignty belong to You. You have no partner.

recommended_dhikr.name: Tahleel
recommended_dhikr.meaning: There is no god except Allah

recommended_dhikr.meaning: Allah is sufficient for us and He is the best disposer of affairs
